name: fresh-origin-reservation-20260924
purpose: Ten newly canonicalized observational metadata-only confirmation candidates, beyond the previous registry/history/ledger union. No executable confirmation, no algorithm settings, no payload verification.

selection_policy.method: Choose the first at most quota[k] completely audited eligible origins per stratum. Incomplete audits are pending, not eligible. No model outcomes, leaderboard rankings or cross-stratum transfers.

rights_summary: Nine original UCI CC-BY-4.0 grants and one linked original PhysioNet CC0 grant; no blanket OpenML license assumption.
parent_actions: Review candidates and freeze algorithm/protocol/budget independently before any model use.
Recheck canonical identity/exposure and rights; then explicitly release reservations and review payload checksums/row counts/classes/selected fold support.
Retain class shortfalls/failures; no replacements chosen from performance, no silent quota redistribution.
Keep all prior final-cohort families labeled exposed in live exposure handling; no reuse as fresh confirmation.

exposure_audit.source_code_identity_search: Read-only Python source search under benchmarks, package, examples and tests found no matching names for the ten selected source origins. Generic names were resolved through explicit UCI/OpenML provenance, not treated as fresh aliases.

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id

exposure_audit.historical_record_policy: All existing registry records, final/draft/release/audit suites and ledger rows are preserved. This audit records current exposure of the prior twelve without relabeling them fresh or rewriting their historical admission records.
exposure_audit.unknown_exposure_policy: Every new family keeps prior_exposure=unknown. No recorded project model match was found, but metadata review is not a guarantee of unrecorded exposure or public model pretraining absence.

datasets.name: communities-crime
datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective community-level normalized ViolentCrimesPerPop annotation from the historical published compilation; not individual criminality, causal demographic attribution or a prospective policing tool.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Remove all five primary-source nonpredictive identifiers/fold fields, including STRING communityname. Retain original normalization/missingness. Source selection and recorded-crime biases must be disclosed; no deployment or geographic-disjoint generalization is approved.

datasets.name: computer-hardware-performance
datasets.prediction_time: Static published relative CPU performance PRP from machine cycle time, memory, cache and channel specifications. OpenML names PRP class. Estimated ERP is absent, as are vendor/model identifiers.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Different origin from exposed cpu-act, which is Sun Sparcstation 20/712 activity telemetry predicting usr. Do not treat ERP fitted by the original authors as a predictor or a new outcome. No future hardware-generation claim.

datasets.name: forest-fires-montesinho
datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective recorded burned area in hectares conditional on the supplied event/weather/fire-index record. Identity target scale, no prospective alert-time or fire-growth horizon is claimed.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Month/day-of-week are not exact event timestamps. IID descriptive response regression, not spatial/event-disjoint or ahead-of-weather forecasting. Native zero-heavy response is retained; no outcome-based filtering.

datasets.name: infrared-oral-temperature
datasets.prediction_time: Contemporaneous oral temperature in monitor mode from measured infrared temperatures, demographic categories and acquisition conditions. Exclude fast-mode oral temperature and SubjectID; not fever diagnosis or future illness prediction.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: This is a heterogeneous clinical measurement/calibration table, not a homogeneous pixel benchmark. IRT-2 and repeated camera/location variants share this origin and are not separate families. No identifiable images, subject reidentification, individual clinical use or hosted row transfer is approved.

datasets.prediction_time: Recorded application approval annotation from the supplied anonymized record. This is not subsequent default, repayment outcome or a prospective credit-risk decision rule.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Prefer original UCI27/OpenML29 with its 67 metadata-reported missing values preserved over Statlog/OpenML40981's undocumented filling/normalization.
